## Summary
A37 is partial-blocked before implementation. This PR adds the required honest-failure blocker report only.

No shadow session capture, replay engine, replay dashboard, migrations, runtime replay comparisons, or sanitization audit results are claimed.

## Replay Coverage
| Requirement | Status |
|---|---|
| Real sessions captured | 0 - blocked |
| Providers used | None - OPENAI_API_KEY/GEMINI_API_KEY unavailable |
| Supabase persistence | Not run - Supabase env vars unavailable |
| Replay runs | 0 - blocked |
| Replay cycles | 0 - blocked |

## Drift Findings
None. Drift findings require real captured sessions and replay runs. Fabricating drift evidence would violate the A37 instructions.

## Sanitization Audit
Not executed. There are no captured shadow sessions to audit, and Supabase/runtime credentials are unavailable.

## Runtime Bugs
No runtime replay bugs are claimed. The blockers documented are:
- Provider/Supabase runtime credentials are unavailable in the sandbox.
- Required Placement V3 context files are missing from the clean `origin/main` branch.
- Any implementation would depend on draft/unmerged Placement V3 work plus a credentialed runtime.

## Risks
- Shadow capture/replay infrastructure remains unimplemented.
- Real provider routing, retries, latency, CEFR drift, taxonomy drift, and recommendation drift remain unverified.
- Production readiness cannot be assessed from this sandbox.

## Evidence
- `docs/placement-v3/shadow-replay/a37-blockers.md`

## Verification
- `git diff --check`: pass
- Commit contains only `docs/placement-v3/shadow-replay/a37-blockers.md`
